player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely declared "DONE" while in the Laundry room, failing to realize that the "west" direction was still unexplored from that location. My previous path (Laundry -> Dining -> Nursery -> Closet -> Laundry -> Studio -> Balcony -> Closet -> Nursery -> Dining -> Laundry) created a loop that returned me to the start without checking all exits. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms and, crucially, track which specific directions have been attempted from each room. Before issuing "DONE", I will verify that every available direction from my current room has been traversed and that no unvisited rooms remain reachable. Specifically, upon returning to the Laundry room the second time, I must execute "GO: west" instead of stopping, as that was the only untried path from that node.
